One day, I started making [42] when I hit. He asked me if I was sick, and I said no. "I heard it would give me more power," I [43] shyly. "Asho, that's absolutely [44]," he replied. "You're not doing any better with it. You're concentrating on grunting(发出哼声) instead of [45]. If you grunt again, I'm walking off this court."

Jim also found ways to get me into trouble. I played my first competition when I was six. I'd been [46] for almost two years, and I was certain I was going to win. But Jim made me [47]. There aren't many lessons to be learned from an easy win. He intentionally found an [48] girl to play me clean off the court.

questions.explanation: 根据下文Jim采取了“故意让作者输”、“告诉对手作者弱点”等不同寻常的训练方法，可知他不仅教作者打球，还教作者用与众不同的方式思考（think differently）。
questions.supplement:
A(differently)：语境句：We need to think differently to solve this complex problem. 固定搭配：think differently, behave differently
B(logically)：语境句：He argued logically and convinced everyone. 固定搭配：think logically, reason logically
C(thoroughly)：语境句：The police searched the house thoroughly. 固定搭配：thoroughly investigate, thoroughly enjoy
D(seriously)：语境句：You must take this matter seriously. 固定搭配：take seriously, seriously injured

questions.explanation: 下文教练提到“You're concentrating on grunting(发出哼声)”，grunting属于发出声音/噪音，因此选noises（发出噪音）。
questions.supplement:
A(mistakes)：语境句：Everyone makes mistakes when learning a new language. 固定搭配：make mistakes, learn from mistakes
B(noises)：语境句：The old engine started making strange noises. 固定搭配：make noises, background noise
C(gestures)：语境句：He made rude gestures at the driver who cut him off. 固定搭配：hand gestures, make a gesture
D(faces)：语境句：The little boy was making funny faces at his sister. 固定搭配：make faces, pull a face

questions.explanation: 作者先是回答了“no”（没生病），然后羞涩地“补充（added）”说听说这样发声能增加力量。hesitated（犹豫），repeated（重复），played（玩耍）均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(hesitated)：语境句：She hesitated for a moment before agreeing to the plan. 固定搭配：hesitate to do, without hesitating
B(repeated)：语境句：The teacher repeated the question for the student. 固定搭配：repeat oneself, repeat after me
C(added)：语境句：He smiled and added that he was happy to help. 固定搭配：add to, add up
D(played)：语境句：The children played outside until it got dark. 固定搭配：play a role, play against

questions.explanation: 教练接着说“You're not doing any better with it.”（你并没有因此打得更好），说明作者认为哼声能增加力量的想法是完全错误的（wrong）。
questions.supplement:
A(correct)：语境句：Make sure your answers are entirely correct. 固定搭配：correct answer, absolutely correct
B(wrong)：语境句：It is wrong to judge people by their appearance. 固定搭配：go wrong, entirely wrong
C(creative)：语境句：She is a highly creative designer with unique ideas. 固定搭配：creative thinking, highly creative
D(sensitive)：语境句：Teenagers are often highly sensitive to criticism. 固定搭配：sensitive to, highly sensitive

questions.explanation: 教练批评作者：你的注意力都集中在发声上，而不是集中在“击球（hitting）”上。与前文的“when I hit”呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(hitting)：语境句：He spent the whole afternoon hitting the tennis ball against the wall. 固定搭配：hit the ball, hit hard
B(jumping)：语境句：The kids were jumping up and down with excitement. 固定搭配：jump up, jump at the chance
C(picking)：语境句：She is picking fresh strawberries in the garden. 固定搭配：pick up, pick out
D(running)：语境句：He goes running every morning to stay fit. 固定搭配：running water, up and running

questions.explanation: 根据前文“I played my first competition when I was six.”以及下文“certain I was going to win”，作者已经“练习（practising）”了近两年，所以觉得肯定能赢。
questions.supplement:
A(complaining)：语境句：Customers were complaining about the poor service. 固定搭配：complain about, complain of
B(changing)：语境句：The weather in this region is constantly changing. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change into
C(recalling)：语境句：He had trouble recalling the details of the accident. 固定搭配：recall doing something, beyond recall
D(practising)：语境句：She spends hours practising the piano every day. 固定搭配：practise doing, out of practice

questions.explanation: 后文提到“There aren't many lessons to be learned from an easy win.”（轻松的胜利学不到多少东西），所以教练是故意让作者“输（lose）”。
questions.supplement:
A(defend)：语境句：Troops were sent to defend the borders of the country. 固定搭配：defend against, defend oneself
B(win)：语境句：We are confident that our team will win the match. 固定搭配：win a prize, win over
C(lose)：语境句：If you don't practice, you will lose the game. 固定搭配：lose weight, lose one's way
D(regret)：语境句：I regret to inform you that your application was rejected. 固定搭配：regret doing, express regret

questions.explanation: 教练为了确保作者输掉比赛，故意找了一个“有经验的（experienced）”女孩来把作者打得落花流水。
questions.supplement:
A(experienced)：语境句：We need an experienced programmer for this complex project. 固定搭配：highly experienced, experienced in
B(ambitious)：语境句：He is an ambitious young lawyer who wants to be a partner. 固定搭配：highly ambitious, overly ambitious
C(outgoing)：语境句：Her outgoing personality makes her popular among colleagues. 固定搭配：outgoing personality, friendly and outgoing
D(informed)：语境句：Consumers should make informed choices when buying products. 固定搭配：keep someone informed, informed decision

questions.explanation: 作者11岁时越级与14岁的女孩“竞争/比赛（competing）”，符合体育比赛的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(observing)：语境句：The scientists are closely observing the behavior of the monkeys. 固定搭配：observe closely, observe the law
B(doubting)：语境句：I am doubting whether he is telling the truth. 固定搭配：without doubt, reason for doubting
C(competing)：语境句：Several companies are competing for the same contract. 固定搭配：compete against, compete for
D(waiting)：语境句：I have been waiting for the bus for over half an hour. 固定搭配：wait for, keep someone waiting

questions.explanation: 教练去告诉对手如何打败作者，因为他“知道（knew）”只有导致失败，作者才会更加关注自己的弱点。
questions.supplement:
A(warned)：语境句：The weather report warned of heavy rain tonight. 固定搭配：warn someone about, warn against
B(heard)：语境句：I heard that you are moving to a new city. 固定搭配：hear of, hear from
C(guessed)：语境句：He correctly guessed the answer to the riddle. 固定搭配：guess right, keep someone guessing
D(knew)：语境句：She knew exactly what to say to comfort her friend. 固定搭配：know about, know for sure

questions.explanation: 教练告诉对手去打作者的低位正手，这是作者的“弱点（weaknesses）”。只有输球，作者才会重视自己的弱点。
questions.supplement:
A(scores)：语境句：The final scores were displayed on the large screen. 固定搭配：high scores, settle a score
B(weaknesses)：语境句：Every system has its strengths and weaknesses. 固定搭配：overcome weaknesses, human weakness
C(balls)：语境句：The children were throwing snow balls at each other. 固定搭配：play ball, catch the ball
D(strengths)：语境句：You should choose a career that plays to your strengths. 固定搭配：inner strength, build strength

questions.explanation: 后文教练说“One day you'll catch her.”（总有一天你会赶上她的），再结合“finally, I did”，说明作者当时一直试图“追赶（catching）”她却总是输。
questions.supplement:
A(missing)：语境句：He is missing his family while studying abroad. 固定搭配：go missing, missing from
B(beating)：语境句：He was accused of severely beating the stray dog. 固定搭配：take a beating, beating heart
C(inspiring)：语境句：The leader's speech was incredibly inspiring to the team. 固定搭配：an inspiring story, highly inspiring
D(catching)：语境句：The police are catching the suspect who ran away. 固定搭配：catch up with, catch sight of

questions.explanation: 作者总是输给同一个对手，教练喜欢看到作者被这样“挑战（challenged）”，直到作者急得哭出来。
questions.supplement:
A(praised)：语境句：The teacher praised the student for his excellent work. 固定搭配：praise someone for, highly praised
B(blamed)：语境句：He blamed his failure on bad luck. 固定搭配：blame someone for, take the blame
C(challenged)：语境句：Students need to be challenged to reach their full potential. 固定搭配：feel challenged, strongly challenged
D(respected)：语境句：He is a highly respected doctor in the local community. 固定搭配：highly respected, widely respected

questions.explanation: 终于打败那个女孩后，作者带着惊讶又满足的表情“转向（turned to）”教练，期待得到认可。
questions.supplement:
A(turned to)：语境句：When she was in trouble, she turned to her parents for help. 固定搭配：turn to someone, turn to page...
B(looked after)：语境句：She stayed at home and looked after her sick mother. 固定搭配：look after oneself, well looked after
C(talked about)：语境句：They enthusiastically talked about their recent trip to Paris. 固定搭配：talk about something, widely talked about
D(aimed at)：语境句：The new policy is aimed at reducing unemployment. 固定搭配：aim at doing, specifically aimed at

questions.explanation: 前文提到“There aren't many lessons to be learned...”，结尾总结说，无论输赢，教练教给作者的这些宝贵的“教训/经验（lessons）”都在持续影响她。
questions.supplement:
A(answers)：语境句：The students eagerly shouted out the answers. 固定搭配：find answers, correct answers
B(wishes)：语境句：We send our best wishes for your future happiness. 固定搭配：best wishes, express wishes
C(lessons)：语境句：He learned valuable lessons from his previous failures. 固定搭配：learn a lesson, teach someone a lesson
D(arguments)：语境句：They had fierce arguments over how to spend the money. 固定搭配：get into arguments, strong arguments

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take hold of and lift something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，picked up 是 pick up 的过去式，表示一次性动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: He picks up the racquet and starts to play.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他拿起球拍开始打球。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I first picked up a racquet and ball when I was four.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a piece of sports equipment used to hit the ball in tennis, badminton, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为单数形式，与不定冠词 a 连用。
vocab_pack.example_en: She bought a new racquet for the tournament.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她为比赛买了一把新球拍。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I first picked up a racquet and ball when I was four.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who trains a sports player or team
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语（my first tennis coach），名词短语的中心词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The coach gave us a new training plan.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教练给了我们新的训练计划。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Jim Joyce, my first tennis coach, was teaching me to play and think differently.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to produce sound, often in a distracting or unnecessary way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动名词短语（making noises），作 started 的宾语，表示开始做某事。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please stop making noise while others are studying.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 别人学习时请不要发出噪音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One day, I started making noises when I hit.

vocab_pack.definition_en: completely incorrect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用作表语（that's absolutely wrong），absolutely 修饰 wrong 加强语气。
vocab_pack.example_en: His answer was absolutely wrong.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的答案完全错误。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Asho, that's absolutely wrong," he replied.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give all your attention to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词形式（concentrating on），与 were 构成过去进行时？实际是 You're concentrating on grunting ，现在进行时。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should concentrate on your studies instead of distractions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该专注于学习而不是分心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You're concentrating on grunting instead of hitting.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a short, low sound (often when exerting effort)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在条件句 If you grunt again 中为动词原形，一般现在时，表示假设。
vocab_pack.example_en: He grunts every time he lifts the heavy weight.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他每次举起重物时都会发出哼声。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "If you grunt again, I'm walking off this court."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to leave a place, especially in a determined or angry way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在进行时（I'm walking off），表示即将发生的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: If he gets angry, he will walk off the field.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果他生气了，他会离开球场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I'm walking off this court."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to be in a difficult or problematic situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语（to get me into trouble），作定语修饰 ways。get 为原形，me 为宾语，into trouble 为介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: His curiosity often gets him into trouble.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的好奇心常常让他陷入麻烦。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Jim also found ways to get me into trouble.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take part in a contest or match
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时，played 是 play 的过去式，my first competition 作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She played her first competition at the age of ten.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她十岁时参加了第一次比赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I played my first competition when I was six.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to train or rehearse in preparation for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去完成进行时（had been practising for）的现在分词部分，表示持续到过去的某个时间。
vocab_pack.example_en: He practises for the exam every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他每天为考试而练习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'd been practising for almost two years

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be sure or confident about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时，was 为系动词，certain 作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am certain that we will win the match.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我确信我们会赢得比赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was certain I was going to win.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to be defeated
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为 make 的过去式 made，后接宾语 me 和省略 to 的不定式 lose，表示致使。
vocab_pack.example_en: The coach made him lose on purpose to teach a lesson.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教练故意让他输，以吸取教训。
vocab_pack.from_passage: But Jim made me lose.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a victory that is achieved with little effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词 from 的宾语，名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: There are few lessons to be learned from an easy win.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从轻松的胜利中能学到的教训很少。
vocab_pack.from_passage: There aren't many lessons to be learned from an easy win.

vocab_pack.definition_en: on purpose; deliberately
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰动词 found，作状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He intentionally made a mistake to test the system.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他故意犯了一个错误来测试系统。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He intentionally found an experienced girl to play me clean off the court.

vocab_pack.term: play someone clean off the court
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: play me clean off the court
vocab_pack.definition_en: to defeat someone thoroughly, especially in a sports match
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 彻底击败某人（尤指体育比赛）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语（to play me clean off the court），作目的状语。play 为原形，clean off the court 是固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: The champion played his opponent clean off the court.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冠军以绝对优势击败了对手。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He intentionally found an experienced girl to play me clean off the court.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a set of beliefs or principles that guide one's actions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语，单数形式，谓语动词 extended 用第三人称单数？实际是 This philosophy extended，单数主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: His philosophy of hard work helped him succeed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他勤奋工作的理念帮助他成功了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This philosophy extended to everything I did.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to include or affect something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时，extended 是 extend 的过去式，to 为介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new rule extends to all students in the school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新规定适用于学校的所有学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This philosophy extended to everything I did.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move out of something, especially with effort; to emerge from a lower level
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 爬出；脱离（某种状态或级别）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动名词短语（climbing out of），作 remember 的宾语，表示回忆过去的情况。
vocab_pack.example_en: He climbed out of the pool after swimming.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他游泳后爬出了游泳池。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I remember climbing out of my age group competing when I was 11 against a 14-year-old girl.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take part in a contest with someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词形式（competing against），与 climbing out of 并列，作 remember 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Our team will compete against the best school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们队将与最好的学校竞争。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I remember climbing out of my age group competing when I was 11 against a 14-year-old girl.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a flaw or a disadvantage; a point where someone is not strong
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式（weaknesses），作介词 to 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He worked on his weaknesses to improve his game.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他努力改进弱点以提升自己的水平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He knew I would pay more attention to my weaknesses if they led to losses.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to result in; to cause something to happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时，led 是 lead 的过去式，to 为介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hard work leads to success.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 努力工作带来成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: …if they led to losses.

vocab_pack.definition_en: starting from that time and continuing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用作时间状语，位于句首，首字母大写。
vocab_pack.example_en: From then on, she studied harder and got better grades.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从那时起，她更努力学习了，成绩也提高了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: From then on, I began winning quickly.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to succeed in reaching or overtaking someone, especially in a race or competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在 you'll catch her 中为动词原形，与情态动词 will 构成一般将来时。
vocab_pack.example_en: I hope I can catch the leading runner before the finish line.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我希望能在终点前追上领先的跑步者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "One day you'll catch her."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be defeated by someone in a contest
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动名词短语（losing to），与 catching 并列，构成过去进行时（was forever catching her, endlessly losing to her）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He often loses to his older brother in chess.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他下棋经常输给他的哥哥。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was forever catching her, endlessly losing to her.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something; to persist
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为祈使句，动词原形开头，表示鼓励。
vocab_pack.example_en: Keep going, and you will achieve your goal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 继续下去，你会实现目标的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Keep going," he said.

vocab_pack.definition_en: remaining calm and composed, just like always
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用作表语（was as cool as ever），as...as 比较结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: Even after winning the championship, he was as cool as ever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 即使赢得了冠军，他也一如既往地冷静。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Jim was as cool as ever.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a useful piece of knowledge or experience gained from a situation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 宝贵的教训；有益的启示
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式（valuable lessons），作主语，谓语动词 influence 用原形（第三人称复数）。
vocab_pack.example_en: This experience taught me a valuable lesson about patience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这段经历教会了我关于耐心的宝贵一课。
vocab_pack.from_passage: These valuable lessons continuously influence me whether I win or lose.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an effect on someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时，主语 These valuable lessons 为复数，谓语动词用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teachers influence the future of their students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师影响着学生的未来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: These valuable lessons continuously influence me whether I win or lose.

section_2_word_form.passage:
In the splendid history of Chinese ceramics(陶瓷制品), there is a name that shines brilliantly — Jingdezhen. This ancient porcelain capital [56] the glory and heritage of a thousand years of porcelain culture.

Jingdezhen was formerly known as Xinping and got its name because the porcelain ware made for the court in the Jingde period of the Song dynasty [57] "Made in the Jingde period". Since then, the reputation of Jingde has spread through the country, becoming related to Chinese ceramics. The [58] of porcelain produced here is vast and of superb quality. For example, the elegant and delicate Yingqing porcelain with [59] mixture of blue and white colors resembles a painting from a fairyland.

During the Ming and Qing [60], Jingdezhen became the center [61] the national porcelain industry, attracting countless skilled craftsmen to contribute talents, and their porcelain-making techniques, [62] promoted Jingdezhen porcelain to unprecedented heights in terms of craftsmanship shape and decoration.

Today, Jingdezhen still maintains its [63] position in the Chinese ceramics industry. Stepping into Jingdezhen is like entering a living epic of ceramics. The ancient kiln fire's(窑火的) exquisite craftsmanship [64] generations of creativity have [65] formed the glory and heritage of this millennium porcelain capital.

questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语动词，主语“This ancient porcelain capital”为单数，讲述客观事实或当前状态，用一般现在时，故填carries。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carries)：语境句：This ancient tradition carries great cultural significance. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on。原词carry其它变形：carrier(n. 载体/搬运工), carry-on(adj. 可随身携带的)

questions.explanation: 因为在宋朝景德年间为宫廷制作的瓷器“被命名为”‘景德年制’，表示过去发生的被动动作，用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was named)：语境句：The new library was named after the generous donor. 固定搭配：be named after, be named as。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 即，也就是), unnamed(adj. 未命名的)

questions.explanation: The ... of... 结构中缺名词。vary的名词形式为variety。The variety of 意为“……的种类”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(variety)：语境句：The supermarket offers a wide variety of fresh fruits. 固定搭配：a variety of, wide variety。原词vary其它变形：various(adj. 各种各样的), invariably(adv. 总是，不变地)

questions.explanation: 修饰名词mixture，需要用形容词性物主代词its，指代前文的“Yingqing porcelain”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The company is famous for its innovative products. 固定搭配：in its own right, on its own。原词it其它变形：itself(pron. 它自己)

questions.explanation: 由“the Ming and Qing”可知这里指明清两个朝代，故用复数形式dynasties。
questions.supplement: 正确形(dynasties)：语境句：Many ancient dynasties contributed to the rich history of China. 固定搭配：ancient dynasties, successive dynasties。原词dynasty无常见词缀变形。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配“the center of...”，意为“……的中心”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(of)：语境句：New York City is often considered the financial center of the world. 固定搭配：the center of, instead of。无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是“porcelain-making techniques”（物），在从句中作主语，故填关系代词which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the difficult exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, of which。无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词position需要形容词，lead的形容词形式为leading，意为“领先的，主导的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(leading)：语境句：She played a leading role in the successful completion of the project. 固定搭配：leading role, leading position。原词lead其它变形：leader(n. 领导者), leadership(n. 领导力)

questions.explanation: 连接两个并列的主语成分“exquisite craftsmanship”与“generations of creativity”，表示并列关系，填and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：Hard work and determination are the keys to success. 固定搭配：both... and..., back and forth。无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 formed 需要用副词形式，joint的副词为jointly，意为“共同地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(jointly)：语境句：The project was jointly funded by several international organizations. 固定搭配：jointly owned, jointly developed。原词joint其它变形：joint(adj. 共同的 / n. 关节)

vocab_pack.definition_en: very impressive; magnificent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰history，表示“辉煌的历史”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The splendid scenery of the mountains left us speechless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 山脉壮丽的景色让我们目瞪口呆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In the splendid history of Chinese ceramics

vocab_pack.definition_en: to shine with great brightness or excellence
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中shines是第三人称单数一般现在时，brilliantly是副词修饰shine。整个短语作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The diamond necklace shines brilliantly under the light.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那条钻石项链在灯光下闪闪发光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there is a name that shines brilliantly — Jingdezhen

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have or contain something; to bear
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中carries是第三人称单数一般现在时，及物动词，宾语为the glory and heritage。
vocab_pack.example_en: This ancient bridge carries a rich history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古桥承载着丰富的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This ancient porcelain capital carries the glory and heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: fame, honor, and admiration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词，与heritage并列，是carries的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team fought for glory in the final match.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这支队伍在决赛中为荣耀而战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carries the glory and heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: traditions, achievements, and beliefs that are part of the history of a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 同上，与glory并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should preserve our cultural heritage for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该为后代保护我们的文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carries the glory and heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular name or reputation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中was known as为一般过去时被动语态，formerly是副词修饰known。主语Jingdezhen。
vocab_pack.example_en: This plant is known as the 'king of herbs'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种植物被称为“草药之王”。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Jingdezhen was formerly known as Xinping

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive a particular name
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中got是get的过去式，its是物主代词，作谓语。后面接because从句说明原因。
vocab_pack.example_en: The park got its name from the founder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个公园以创始人的名字命名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: got its name because the porcelain ware

vocab_pack.definition_en: to produce something for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中made为过去分词，与was构成被动语态，表示“为宫廷制作”。
vocab_pack.example_en: This chair is made for comfort.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这把椅子是为舒适而制作的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the porcelain ware made for the court

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be given a name
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中was named是一般过去时被动语态，后接直接引语“Made in the Jingde period”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bridge was named after the engineer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座桥以工程师的名字命名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was named "Made in the Jingde period"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gradually affect or become known in all parts of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中has spread是现在完成时，through是介词，后接the country。主语the reputation。
vocab_pack.example_en: The rumor quickly spread through the town.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 谣言迅速传遍了整个小镇。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the reputation of Jingde has spread through the country

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become connected or associated with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中becoming是现在分词，构成伴随状语，related to是过去分词短语作表语。表示结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: These two issues become related to each other over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这两个问题随时间变得相互关联。
vocab_pack.from_passage: becoming related to Chinese ceramics

vocab_pack.definition_en: very large in size, amount, or number
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，与is构成系表结构，主语是The variety。
vocab_pack.example_en: The vast ocean stretches beyond the horizon.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 浩瀚的海洋延伸到地平线以外。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The variety of porcelain produced here is vast

vocab_pack.definition_en: excellent; of very high quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在of superb quality中，superb修饰quality，构成介词短语作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel offers superb service to its guests.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家酒店为客人提供极好的服务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and of superb quality

vocab_pack.definition_en: graceful and stylish
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与delicate并列作定语修饰Yingqing porcelain。
vocab_pack.example_en: She wore an elegant gown to the ball.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她穿着一件优雅的礼服去参加舞会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the elegant and delicate Yingqing porcelain

vocab_pack.definition_en: fine and subtle; easily damaged
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 同上，与elegant并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The delicate flower cannot withstand strong wind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这朵娇嫩的花经不起强风。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the elegant and delicate Yingqing porcelain

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look like or be similar to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中resembles是第三人称单数一般现在时，及物动词，宾语为a painting。
vocab_pack.example_en: His latest painting resembles a photograph.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他最新的画作像一张照片。
vocab_pack.from_passage: resembles a painting from a fairyland

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become the most important part or focal point
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中became是一般过去时，the center of后接the national porcelain industry。
vocab_pack.example_en: This small town became the center of the textile industry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个小镇成为了纺织业的中心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Jingdezhen became the center of the national porcelain industry

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause to come near or participate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中attracting是现在分词，作伴随状语，表示结果或伴随。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new museum attracts many visitors every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新博物馆每天吸引许多游客。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attracting countless skilled craftsmen

vocab_pack.definition_en: too many to be counted; very many
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰skilled craftsmen。
vocab_pack.example_en: There are countless stars shining in the night sky.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 夜空中有无数颗星星在闪烁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attracting countless skilled craftsmen

vocab_pack.definition_en: having the skills and experience needed to do something well
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 同上，修饰craftsmen。
vocab_pack.example_en: Skilled workers are essential for this project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 熟练工人对这个项目至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attracting countless skilled craftsmen

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who makes things skillfully by hand
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中craftsmen是复数形式，作attracting的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The old craftsman taught his apprentice many skills.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老工匠教了徒弟很多手艺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attracting countless skilled craftsmen

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something (such as money, time, or effort) to help achieve something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中to contribute是不定式，表示目的，talents是宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Everyone should contribute to the team effort.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都应该为团队努力做出贡献。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to contribute talents

vocab_pack.definition_en: a way of doing something using special skills
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中techniques是复数，指各种制作技术。
vocab_pack.example_en: Learning new techniques can improve your painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学习新技术可以提高你的绘画水平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their porcelain-making techniques

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help something to happen, develop, or increase
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中promoted是过去式，作定语从句的谓语，后接Jingdezhen porcelain to unprecedented heights。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise promotes good health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经常锻炼促进健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which promoted Jingdezhen porcelain to unprecedented heights

vocab_pack.definition_en: never done or known before
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰heights。
vocab_pack.example_en: The country achieved unprecedented economic growth.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个国家实现了史无前例的经济增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: unprecedented heights

vocab_pack.definition_en: a high position or level
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中heights为复数形式，指抽象的高度，与unprecedented搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: The athlete reached new heights in her career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位运动员在她的职业生涯中达到了新的高度。
vocab_pack.from_passage: unprecedented heights

vocab_pack.definition_en: with regard to; concerning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词短语，引出后面的方面craftsmanship, shape and decoration。
vocab_pack.example_en: This product is superior in terms of quality and price.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个产品在质量和价格方面都更优越。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in terms of craftsmanship shape and decoration

vocab_pack.definition_en: skill in making things by hand
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在第三段出现于"in terms of craftsmanship shape and decoration"中，作名词；第四段也出现。这里取第三段的用法。
vocab_pack.example_en: The craftsmanship of this antique is remarkable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这件古董的工艺很出色。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in terms of craftsmanship shape and decoration

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep something in a particular state or condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中maintains是第三人称单数一般现在时，宾语是its leading position。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to maintain a healthy diet.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保持健康饮食很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Jingdezhen still maintains its leading position

vocab_pack.definition_en: a top or foremost place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作maintain的宾语，前面有its。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company holds a leading position in the global market.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司在全球市场上占据领先地位。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its leading position

vocab_pack.definition_en: to walk into; to enter (often figuratively)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中Stepping是现在分词，作状语，表示“步入景德镇”。
vocab_pack.example_en: As soon as you step into the room, you feel the warmth.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你一走进房间，就能感受到温暖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Stepping into Jingdezhen

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely beautiful and delicate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰craftsmanship，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum displayed an exquisite collection of jade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆展出了一批精美的玉器收藏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the ancient kiln fire's exquisite craftsmanship
